claims.title: Ideal variable-order sampling: cube-root-log cost balance and unpaid oracle/TV interfaces

quoted_fields.interface: Unknown V in C^2(R^d),d>=2, I<=Hess V<=2I, known minimizer0. Access ONLY exact (V(x),grad V(x)), no warm sample, Hessian, prox, smoothed-gradient, conditional-sampling or normalizer oracle. Ideal continuous-randomness/real-arithmetic model permits standard Gaussian/uniform draws and specified scalar operations; vector work is charged by scalar cost. Target is the ENTIRE original law in TV1/10, not Wasserstein or finite-bit software.
quoted_fields.failure: Exact SMOOTHED gradient access and ideal-kernel costs are premises. W2 is not original-target TV; constant smoothing bias and growing-order recursion cannot be ignored. No finite-bit implementation, strong-oracle reduction, full sharp-scale sampling algorithm, matched full negative, practical or novelty claim. Current lower bound/upper papers are imported only at the read sections and exact source scopes. No governing theorem from unread Chen26g or held OpenAI upper original is used. New wrong PMLR EDIT route https://github.com/mlresearch/v336/edit/gh-pages/_posts/2026-06-29-chen26g.md was robots denied: UNREAD/HELD, no retry/alternate; all older known/unknown holds persist. CONTINUATION: Full sharp-scale first-order sampler exp(C log^(1/3)(d+2)) queries and a stronger negative excluding every C both remain OPEN. Auxiliary source proofs are accepted only at their literal scopes: existing-guarantee incompatibility, exact-score stronger-oracle separation, conditional capping and a slower original-oracle baseline. A published RGO UPPER bound is not an intrinsic lower bound. Exact-score separation is not approximate-TV sampling hardness. Capping assumes the desired paid expected construction rather than supplying it. Standard entropy/Girsanov/Euler and Markov methods are imported once; no novelty or practical-device claim. Full native prompt/answer and all provided visible activity retained unchanged; no producer ZIP visible. Website activity counts are not governing-proof reads, hidden-helper or compute evidence. All known/unknown source/access/transfer holds remain, including unread wrong PMLR edit route and held OpenAI original. Missing cost control must not be reported as absence of any conversion theorem. Exact-score separation also does not preclude paid unbiased estimation.
